statement: ControllerInterface sets up one MP mapping 04/05/07. When active MP reports a downstream child but cached ID is unknown, it may read A400F6/4 then later A40040/16 calibration for a recognized ordinary child. Its reviewed task path does not recursively probe downstream MP identity or instantiate a second gyro. A physically stacked MP may present unknown child data or stall setup; outcomes are unmeasured.
